_comment: Copy this file to ~/.config/nfx-cowork-export/cwd-allowlist.json (or the Windows equivalent), then edit the prefix lists to fit your environment. The exporter refuses to run if no cwd-allowlist.json is found — this is intentional (fail-closed posture against accidentally ingesting non-IT-work sessions).

_three_buckets.alwaysAllow: Path prefixes that are unconditionally allowed. Typically the Cowork sandbox path '/sessions/' — events inside Cowork's own sandbox are filtered separately by the slug blocklist.
_three_buckets.allowPrefixes: Path prefixes for your real laptop folders that you want ingested. Be specific: list only the project folders relevant to NexFortis pillar work.
_three_buckets.alwaysDeny: Path prefixes that are unconditionally denied even if they'd otherwise match. Typically Cowork's internal-data folder to keep scheduled-task and meta-session noise out.
